comments: Energy gap is scientifically plausible but the proposal is only shared vocabulary; no concrete mechanism or nontrivial prediction.
Thermal differential is plausible but generic; the proposal lacks domain-specific mechanism and rigorous falsification.
Surface chemical modification has potential but is underspecified; needs concrete chemistry, domains, and measurable transfer.
Phase change enthalpy is real but proposal lacks a specific mechanistic hypothesis; counterexample is a benchmark artifact.
Heat is far too generic to be a discovery bridge; high risk of recognition-only scoring.
Likely photon-energy concept, but awkwardly specified and not grounded in a concrete cross-domain mechanism.
